lines.1: All right, time for high risk, high reward.
lines.2: I was going for one big hit.
lines.5: I couldn't hit that, so I wasn't swinging.
lines.6: Give me a fastball. Come on, fastball.
lines.7: Second pitch, a high inside fastball.
lines.9: I swung with everything I had.
lines.10: The ball sailed deep into the outfield.
lines.11: 「Not bad, but the wind's against it... Too bad.」
lines.12: The right fielder backed up and made a clean catch.
